summary: Operational procedure for migrating one Product from the predecessor through the delivered importer: a per-Product harvest of the sanctioned read surface with pinned derivation rules and fail-closed inventory validation, a rehearsed import with declared Product identity, full project set, and deliberately selected active work, followed by predecessor freeze for that Product, fix-forward, wisdom curation through the formalization procedure, and frozen snapshots as the historical record. Guidance for a correct operation under CD-0082, not a mandated gate.
title: Predecessor migration runbook
